assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and all three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional.
assumptions.impact: All locations and projected areas must be recomputed from official polygons.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, heritage and existing-building geometry are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory FAR, height, density, setback, demolition or engineering claim is made.

assumptions.statement: Three observatories, twelve scenario windows and three pilot gates are conceptual operating units.
assumptions.impact: Final count, ownership, thresholds and budgets require co-design and approval.

assumptions.statement: Identity-blind, aggregate or on-device data is the default; a staffed fallback remains available.
assumptions.impact: Each implemented scenario still requires legal, security and accessibility review.
